result.stdout:
Usage: spdev <file.sql> --connection <connstr> [--port 52341] [--param key=value] [--include-try]

Arguments:
  file.sql          Path to the .sql file to debug
  --connection, -c  SQL Server connection string (required)
  --port, -p        Trace server port (default: 52341)
  --param, -k       Parameters in key=value format (repeatable)
  --include-try, -t Include TRY block traces
